```sql
WITH f AS (
  SELECT o.id
    FROM orders o
   WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
     AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
     AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
     AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT ol.order_id, pv.product_id, pv.id AS variant_id,
         ol.quantity, ol.line_total_cents
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN f ON f.id = ol.order_id
    JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
),
per_order AS (
  SELECT product_id, order_id,
         sum(quantity)           AS quantity,
         sum(line_total_cents)   AS revenue_cents
    FROM lines
   GROUP BY product_id, order_id
),
per_product AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         count(*)                        AS order_count,
         sum(quantity)::bigint           AS quantity,
         sum(revenue_cents)              AS revenue_cents
    FROM per_order
   GROUP BY product_id
),
variants AS (
  SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM lines) d
   GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       pp.order_count,
       pp.quantity,
       pp.revenue_cents,
       vc.variant_count
  FROM per_product pp
  JOIN variants vc ON vc.product_id = pp.product_id
  JOIN products p  ON p.id = pp.product_id
 ORDER BY pp.quantity DESC, pp.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De distincte tellingen (orders en varianten) worden nu berekend op voorgeaggregeerde groepen, zodat er niet meer op 81k regels met `DISTINCT` gesorteerd hoeft te worden en de productjoin pas na de aggregatie plaatsvindt. Het resultaat blijft gelijk: de kolomtypes zijn behouden (`quantity` als bigint, omzet als numeric) en de `ORDER BY` is ongewijzigd, dus gelijkspel is even ongedefinieerd als in het origineel. De werkelijke winst moet je met `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)` op representatieve data verifiëren, want die is niet gegarandeerd.
